Definition

A finite-dimensional representation of a finite-dimensional Lie algebra $\mathfrak g$ is a Lie algebra homomorphism $\varphi \colon \mathfrak g\to \mathfrak {gl}(V)$ for a finite-dimensional vector space $V$. It is faithful if $\varphi $ is injective; then $\mathfrak g\cong \varphi (\mathfrak g)\subseteq \mathfrak {gl}(V)$.
